assets.variant: Red-leaf Japanese maple with a curving trunk and layered airy crown
assets.prompt: A single stylised Japanese red maple tree, full view from trunk base to crown top, three-quarter view, centred, isolated on a plain light grey background. Slender curving dark grey-brown trunk splitting into several organic branches, an irregular airy crown of layered deep crimson and scarlet leaf clusters with gaps showing the branches through, natural asymmetric silhouette (not round or ball-shaped). Clean game-asset concept render, soft even lighting, no shadow on the ground, no text.
assets.reference_review: Reference image reviewed on 2026-11-20 at full resolution (1024 px): an isolated tree on a plain grey background; no lettering, logos or marks.

assets.variant: Mature green broadleaf (zelkova or elm type) with flared roots and a vase-shaped crown
assets.prompt: A single mature green broadleaf tree like a zelkova or elm, full view from trunk base to crown top, three-quarter view, centred, isolated on a plain light grey background. Thick gnarled trunk with visible roots flaring at the base, branching into several twisting limbs, a wide irregular vase-shaped crown of layered fresh green leaf clusters with open gaps and drooping edges, natural asymmetric silhouette (not round or ball-shaped). Clean game-asset concept render, soft even lighting, no ground shadow, no text.
